## What you want to add

## Which of the seven parts it belongs to

Employees, principles, tools, documentation, workflow, board, or log — and why
it belongs there rather than another.

## Would a good model have done this anyway?

**This is the question that decides most proposals.** A model already knows what
the common practices and popular libraries are; writing that down costs an agent
context it needs for the actual task.

Say what a model would *not* already know. Local knowledge — a team's
conventions, a project's decisions, an organisation's definition of done — is
what belongs here.

## If it adds a node

Roughly how many words for the always-loaded core, and what goes in references
instead?

## If it adds a host

Which of the four verification states is it in, and what did you actually run?
